description: Selected-account scoped userdata settings from cPanel 11.32. Preserve exact scalar inputs and required private maps with mixed JSON entries through existing object-to-array handling. Both pinned GET variants are non-read-only; form POST acceptance and mixed response shapes were observed at original 08dacc43 on 11.138.0.19, not on this corrected candidate. Live follow-up whm-api-client-8x0.2.74 remains open.

notes.text: The pinned 11.138.0.10 source declares GET, x-readonly=false, x-rollback=none and cPanel 11.32 with no role or plugin restriction. Its additionalProperties string schema is the original contract contradicted by the separately attributed runtime observations.

Review 5725906568 of original 08dacc43c15a6d58aa536da8352a3696642d129f on 11.138.0.19 observed both operations as POST through direct UAPI and the WHM bridge. The separate root 25-call artifact at that revision/build confirms mixed writes persisted before response mismatches and later reads also mismatched. These are bounded original-head observations, not current-candidate runtime or every-version guarantees.

That original review observed the getter on a new scope creating its scoped directory and attributed this to Guard::new_scoped calling CREATE_SCOPED_USERDATA_DIRS. This does not prove why x-readonly=false was chosen, universal path confinement or behavior on every build.

Return a required nonnullable dynamic map with mixed decoded JSON entries. Preserve scalar values and null without scalar coercion; existing mixed handling copies lists and recursively converts objects to associative PHP arrays. Numeric object keys follow PHP conversion and empty object/list identity may collapse. Arbitrary keys remain; missing/null data and scalar/nonempty-list roots fail. Empty-object and inherited empty-array map compatibility remain.

At original 08dacc43 on 11.138.0.19, reviewer t/n/f/l/o shapes returned integer 1 and float 1.5 on write, then strings 1 and 1.5 on read, with null/list/object entries retained. These are server representation observations, not client scalar normalization; accepting other decoded JSON values is compatibility policy. Reviewer Cpanel::JSON::Load source attribution is not retained authenticated implementation bytes or an implementation-file hash.

Use one form POST. scope/json/key/value remain exact scalar strings encoded once; json is a raw form field, not an application/json body. No local JSON parsing, reserialization, input normalization, format validation or implicit mode choice is added.

Scope identities, keys, values, results, errors, responseMeta() and PayloadMismatchException::$payload can expose private account settings. All input parameters remain sensitive. Library-owned frames conceal private inputs and response/error arguments; third-party transports control their own traces. Deliberate metadata and payload inspection remains private caller-accessible data; do not log it indiscriminately.

No implicit read, merge, key deletion, readback, retry, rollback, server-settings cache, returned-path access or URL fetch is added. A deliberate caller set/get pair is two invocations. No universal confinement, atomicity, persistence or transaction guarantee is inferred. Offline fixtures establish client behavior; original observations do not establish corrected-head live behavior. Runtime follow-up whm-api-client-8x0.2.74 remains open; root API cleanup is distinct from reviewer cleanup and does not prove filesystem absence.

scope is required; json/key/value are optional strings. Null optional arguments omit and empty strings send. The source forbids json with key/value, while this canonical method forwards all supplied strings and leaves conflicts, key/value pairing and scope-only validity to server validation. Whitespace, duplicate keys, percent/plus/Unicode, empty/malformed/scalar/list JSON text pass through unchanged.
